_comment: WP10_CC0 Poly Haven prop jobs for Tools/cc0/wp10_ph_model.py. tris = LOD0 target for the whole output (rule: manifest budget, but never more than a 50% cut unless 'bake'; small <=0.6 m props capped toward 2k, medium/large toward 8k, hero props keep the manifest number). tex = in-game texture size. lods = ratios of LOD0. parts = separately pivoted children (articulated). variants = separate FBX files from one source. pivot: origin (Poly Haven origin) | bottom (bbox bottom centre) | top (bbox top centre).

PH_FILMSTRIP_PROJECTOR_8MM.name: Projector16mm
PH_FILMSTRIP_PROJECTOR_8MM.note: 8 mm filmstrip projector scaled x1.3 to read as a 16 mm portable projector; feed and take-up reels are separate children pivoted on their axles (spin them about local X).

PH_BINOCULARS.name: Binoculars
PH_BINOCULARS.note: FP view-model prop (Viewmodel layer); strap is a separate child so it can be hidden.

PH_OLD_MILITARY_CRATE.name: OldMilitaryCrate
PH_OLD_MILITARY_CRATE.note: Source holds two crates: A (closed lid) and B (lid open); exported as separate FBX, shared material.

PH_SECURITY_LIGHT.name: SecurityLight
PH_SECURITY_LIGHT.note: Floodlight head; glass is a separate child for the destructible swap.

PH_LARGE_IRON_GATE.name: LargeIronGate
PH_LARGE_IRON_GATE.note: Double gate: leaves pivot on their hinge edges (rotate about local Y), bolt separate.

PH_WOODEN_LADDER.name: WoodenStepLadder
PH_WOODEN_LADDER.note: Poly Haven asset is an A-frame step-ladder (1.33 m): roof dressing only. Ladder L uses SM_WoodenLadderStraight (procedural 3.6 m ladder on the same texture set).

PH_CEILING_FAN.name: CeilingFan
PH_CEILING_FAN.note: Blades are a separate child on the motor axis: spin about local Y.

PH_STEEL_FRAME_SHELVES_01.name: SteelFrameShelves01
PH_STEEL_FRAME_SHELVES_01.note: Source mesh is authored 10x too large (Poly Haven metadata says 1.10 x 0.50 x 2.14 m): scaled x0.1.

PH_DRAWER_CABINET.name: VintageWoodenDrawer01
PH_DRAWER_CABINET.note: Replaces drawer_cabinet (a 2010s loft shelf) with Poly Haven vintage_wooden_drawer_01 (6-drawer wooden filing cabinet): period-correct archive furniture.

PH_OFFICE_NOTEPADS.name: OfficeNotepads
PH_OFFICE_NOTEPADS.note: Separate children per item (pads, stacks, sheets), each pivoted at its bottom centre; not LODs.

PH_WOODENCHAIR_01.name: PaintedWoodenChair02
PH_WOODENCHAIR_01.note: Replaces WoodenChair_01 (a 2.27 m Gothic throne with pointed tracery: religious/church look, GDD 2.3-2) with Poly Haven painted_wooden_chair_02, a worn painted ladder-back cafe chair.

PH_ROCK_07.name: Rock07
PH_ROCK_07.note: Real-world scan size 0.32 m (Poly Haven); used as scalable ridge/wadi rock: uniform scale 3-10 is fine. Source roughness (wet-looking 0.30) raised: smoothness x0.4 for dry desert stone.

PH_ROCK_09.name: Rock09
PH_ROCK_09.note: Real-world scan size 0.15 m (Poly Haven); used as scalable ridge/wadi rock: uniform scale 4-15 is fine. Smoothness x0.5 for dry desert stone.

PH_ROCK_FACE_01.name: RockFace01
PH_ROCK_FACE_01.note: Green moss patches re-tinted to the surrounding rock colour (arid ridge).

PH_NAMAQUALAND_BOULDER_04.name: NamaqualandBoulder04
PH_NAMAQUALAND_BOULDER_04.note: 59k-tri scan decimated to 8k with normal/colour/mask re-baked from the full mesh (Cycles) onto fresh UVs.

PH_DRY_BRANCHES_MEDIUM_01.name: DryBranchesMedium01
PH_DRY_BRANCHES_MEDIUM_01.note: Three separate branches, one FBX each; tris is per branch. Green moss/lichen re-tinted to the local bark colour (arid setting).

PH_DEAD_TREE_TRUNK.name: DeadTreeTrunk
PH_DEAD_TREE_TRUNK.note: 101k-tri scan of a fallen 3 m trunk decimated to 8k with re-baked maps. It is a lying log, not a standing snag. Green moss/lichen re-tinted to the local bark colour (arid setting).
